decision_conditions: The development must achieve reduced water consumption through the use of water efficient fittings, appliances and recycling systems to result in consumption equal to or less than 105 litres per person per day.Reason: To promote water conservation and efficiency measures in all new developments and where possible in the retrofitting of existing stock in accordance with Core Policy 21 of the Core Strategy and the London Plan.

Notwithstanding the provisions of classes A, B, C, D and E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any amending Order), no enlargement, improvement, alteration, buildings, extensions or enclosure to the existing and new buildings hereby approved shall be carried out or erected without the prior approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the area and ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and to prevent the overdevelopment of the site

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of a low boundary wall or other means of enclosure to separate the frontages of the two proposed dwellings have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved boundary shall be constructed in full in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of either dwelling or shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure an appropirate provision and layout of car parking for each dwelling

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Planning Statement Energy StatementHighway Impact Assessment  Location Plan DWL 01PP103PP104PP105PP108PP107Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the 4 long-stay cycle parking spaces (2 for each dwelling) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details should demonstrate:Location: Near entrances or main access Design: Stands or wall bars Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit Coverage: Covered where possible Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructions The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the design and location of refuse and recycling storage facilities for each of the proposed dwellings, to be provided at the frontage of the site and sized to meet the needs of the future occupiers, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the provision and layout of two on-site car parking spaces (one for each dwelling), each served by an existing crossover and dropped kerb, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall also indicate the refuse storage and cycle parking arrangements (as required by conditions 4 and 5) to demonstrate that all required infrastructure can be successfully accommodated at the front of the dwellings. The approved parking spaces shall be laid out, surfaced, and made available for use prior to the first occupation of either dwelling and shall thereafter be retained and kept available for off street car parking for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure the provision of adequate and safe off-street parking for the proposed dwellings, to prevent indiscriminate or unsafe parking, and to safeguard highway safety and the free flow of traffic.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the submitted Energy Statement ref; energy rating, calculations and advise. All approved energy efficiency and low-carbon measures shall be installed before first occupation and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

Prior to first occupation of the residential unit hereby approved, the applicant shall submit to and obtain written approval from the Local Planning Authority of a Final Energy Statement (or SAP/SBEM compliance report) demonstrating that the development has achieved a minimum 35% reduction in CO"² emissions beyond the requirements of Building Regulations Part L 2021. The approved energy efficiency and low carbon measures shall be fully installed prior to first occupation and shall be retained permanently.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO"² emission reduction targets are met, in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014)
description: Conversion of dwelling house to two dwelling houses including part first floor, part two-storey side extension, part single, part 2-storey rear extension, extension to roof incorporating four rear dormers and two storey front extension incorporating a porch entrance.
